118	__device__ __forceinline__ FusedOptState
119	vit_rebase_state(const FusedOptState& s, int64_t off) {

136	// The L3-REAL ViT megakernel needs the FLOAT patch path + a grad-partial
137	// workspace. Kept a SEPARATE kernel + launcher (not folded into the surrogate
138	// fused_megakernel) so the surrogate path is untouched.
139	//
140	// Workspace layout (one flat float buffer the host allocates + the kernel owns):
141	//   [0 .. nCTA*total)              : per-CTA grad partials (cta-major)
142	//   [nCTA*total .. nCTA*total+nCTA): per-CTA loss partials (NLL sum per slice)
143	//   [.. +1)                        : the reduced scalar loss (loss/B) the host reads
144	// total == kVitTotalElems == 418017.
145	struct ViTInputCtx {
146	    const float* patches;  // [B, kNPatch, kPatch] fp32 image patches
147	    const int*   targets;  // [B]                  int32 target ids in [0,kVocab)
148	    int          B;        // batch size
149	    float*       workspace; // grad partials + loss partials + reduced loss
150	    float*       loss_out;  // device float the kernel writes the mean loss into
151	};
152	
153	// ── The persistent megakernel (L3-REAL). gridDim.x = #SMs (one CTA/SM), 256
154	//    threads/CTA. VitSampleSmem (~183.67 KB) lives in DYNAMIC smem (extern). ────
155	// sizes/offsets are NOT host-passed: per-tensor numel/offset live in the
156	// __constant__ tables kVitSizes/kVitOffsets (vit_layout.cuh), read directly by
157	// the reduce + optimizer phases.
158	template <OptId Opt>
159	__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK)
160	fused_vit_megakernel(PersistentContext ctx,
161	                     float* __restrict__ params,
162	                     ViTInputCtx in,
163	                     float* __restrict__ grad,        // reduced grad [total]
164	                     float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
165	    extern __shared__ char vit_smem_raw[];
166	    VitSampleSmem& sm = *reinterpret_cast<VitSampleSmem*>(vit_smem_raw);
167	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
168	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
169	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
170	    const int64_t total = kVitTotalElems;
171	    float* my_partial = in.workspace + (int64_t)cta * total;   // this CTA's dW
172	    float* loss_part = in.workspace + (int64_t)nCTA * total;   // [nCTA]
173	
174	    // §3.4 register repartition (producer WG gives back, consumer WG claims).
175	    const int wg = threadIdx.x / 128;
176	    if (wg == 0) ::sg::sm90::wgs::warpgroup_reg_dealloc<32>();
177	    else         ::sg::sm90::wgs::warpgroup_reg_alloc<200>();
178	
179	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's grad-partial slice + its loss slot. ───────────────
180	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < total; i += blockDim.x) my_partial[i] = 0.0f;
181	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
182	    bar.sync();   // B0
183	
184	    // ── P1: batch-parallel fwd+bwd. Fixed contiguous slice [b0,b1) for this CTA.
185	    VitWeights w = vit_bind(params);
186	    VitGrad g = vit_bind_grad(my_partial);
187	    const int B = in.B;
188	    const int base = B / nCTA, rem = B % nCTA;
189	    const int b0 = cta * base + (cta < rem ? cta : rem);
190	    const int cnt = base + (cta < rem ? 1 : 0);
191	    const int b1 = b0 + cnt;
192	    __shared__ int tgt_s;
193	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;              // fp32 slice accumulator (thread-0 holds it)
194	    const int patch_elems = vit::kNPatch * vit::kPatch;   // 16*49 = 784
195	    for (int b = b0; b < b1; ++b) {
196	        // Load this sample's float patches into smem (cooperative).
197	        const float* src = in.patches + (int64_t)b * patch_elems;
198	        for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < patch_elems; i += blockDim.x)
199	            sm.patch[i / vit::kPatch][i % vit::kPatch] = src[i];
200	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) tgt_s = in.targets[b];
201	        __syncthreads();
202	        float nll = vit_forward_sample(w, tgt_s, &sm);
203	        vit_backward_sample(w, g, tgt_s, B, &sm);
204	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;   // fixed-order fp32 sum within slice
205	        __syncthreads();   // sample boundary: all grad writes done before reuse
206	    }
207	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
208	    bar.sync();   // B1: all CTA partials + loss slots complete
209	
210	    // ── P2: deterministic cross-CTA reduce. Work-steal the param ELEMENT-RANGES
211	    //    (one task = one parameter tensor; sum its elements across CTAs in
212	    //    ascending CTA index). Summation ORDER (ascending cta) is fixed →
213	    //    deterministic regardless of which CTA grabs the task. ─────────────────
214	    {
215	        __shared__ int task_slot;
216	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
217	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kVitNumTensors;
218	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
219	            const int n = kVitSizes[t];
220	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kVitOffsets[t];
221	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x) {
222	                float acc = 0.0f;
223	                for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c)
224	                    acc += in.workspace[(int64_t)c * total + off + i];
225	                grad[off + i] = acc;
226	            }
227	        }
228	    }
229	    // Loss reduction (fp64 ordered) by CTA 0 only — the loss rel-tol is the
230	    // tightest gate; fp32 atomic-summing many terms can miss it.
231	    if (cta == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
232	        double s = 0.0;
233	        for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c) s += (double)loss_part[c];
234	        float mean = (float)(s / (double)B);
235	        *in.loss_out = mean;
236	    }
237	    bar.sync_reset(ctx.g_next_task);   // B2: reduced grad ready; reset queue for P3
238	
239	    // ── P3: the REAL optimizer tail over the reduced grad (work-steal the 32
240	    //    tensors). apply_optimizer<Opt> is the canonical csrc/algorithms math. ──
241	    st.lr = lr;
242	    {
243	        __shared__ int task_slot;
244	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
245	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kVitNumTensors;
246	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
247	            const int n = kVitSizes[t];
248	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kVitOffsets[t];
249	            const FusedOptState ts = vit_rebase_state<Opt>(st, off);
250	            float* __restrict__ p = params + off;
251	            const float* __restrict__ gg = grad + off;
252	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x)
253	                apply_optimizer<Opt>(p, gg, (int64_t)i, step, ts);
254	        }
255	    }
256	}

258	// ── Host launcher — one persistent CTA per SM, 256 threads/CTA (2 warp-groups).
259	//    Mirrors launch_fused_decoder_megakernel's hang-freedom contract (occupancy≥1
260	//    or refuse), PLUS the DYNAMIC-SMEM opt-in that the ViT footprint requires:
261	//      (1) cudaFuncSetAttribute(MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, sizeof(VitSampleSmem))
262	//      (2) dynamicSMemBytes = sizeof(VitSampleSmem) in the occ≥1 query
263	//      (3) dynamicSMemBytes = sizeof(VitSampleSmem) at <<<...>>>
264	//    All three are mandatory; missing any one makes the launch silently fail. ───
265	template <OptId Opt>
266	cudaError_t launch_fused_vit_megakernel(
267	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, ViTInputCtx in,
268	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream) {
269	    int dev = 0;
270	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
271	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
272	    int n_sms = 0;
273	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
274	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
275	
276	    const int dyn_smem = (int)sizeof(VitSampleSmem);   // ≈ 188080 B (183.67 KB)
277	
278	    // (1) Opt in to >48 KB dynamic smem for THIS kernel. Without this the launch
279	    //     fails with cudaErrorInvalidValue (the static 48 KB default applies).
280	    err = cudaFuncSetAttribute(
281	        (const void*)&fused_vit_megakernel<Opt>,
282	        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dyn_smem);
283	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
284	
285	    // (2) Occupancy with the REAL dynamic-smem request (hang-freedom is honest).
286	    int occ = 0;
287	    err = cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
288	        &occ, (const void*)&fused_vit_megakernel<Opt>, SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK,
289	        /*dynamicSMemBytes=*/dyn_smem);
290	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
291	    // At least one CTA per SM must be resident or the grid barrier can never be
292	    // satisfied. ~183.67 KB dynamic smem fits the sm_90 227 KB cap at occ=1 (the
293	    // persistent megakernel is one-CTA-per-SM by design); if it cannot place one
294	    // block/SM, REFUSE rather than hang.
295	    assert(occ >= 1 &&
296	           "fused_vit_megakernel: 0 blocks/SM — GridBarrier would hang. The ViT "
297	           "per-sample smem (~184KB dynamic) + regs exceed one-block-per-SM "
298	           "occupancy on this device; reduce footprint or fall back to eager.");
299	    if (occ < 1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources;
300	
301	    const unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms;
302	    ctx.n_ctas = launch_ctas;
303	
304	    if (ctx.g_arrived) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_arrived, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
305	    if (ctx.g_generation) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_generation, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
306	    if (ctx.g_next_task) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_next_task, 0, sizeof(int), stream); if (err) return err; }
307	
308	    // (3) Launch WITH the dynamic-smem byte count.
309	    dim3 grid(launch_ctas), block(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK);
310	    fused_vit_megakernel<Opt><<<grid, block, dyn_smem, stream>>>(
311	        ctx, params, in, grad, lr, step, st);
312	    return cudaGetLastError();
313	}

316	//  WGMMA CELL DRIVER (DESIGN-TC-PIPELINE.md Fork B, the ViT twin of the decoder
317	//  R2.3 driver). Compiled only under the wgmma token; the scalar path above is
318	//  untouched. The TC path's per-CTA tile scratch lives in HBM (NOT dynamic smem)
319	//  — the only smem the TC kernel needs is the tiny wgmma staging arena (one
320	//  A(64×16) + one B(N×16) bf16 tile + a 256-float reduction + the 10 dW specs),
321	//  which is STATIC (≈ 7 KB), so this kernel — unlike the scalar ViT one — needs
322	//  NO dynamic-smem opt-in. The big ViT activation footprint (which forced the
323	//  scalar path to 184 KB dynamic smem) becomes HBM acts here (Fork B), so the
324	//  occupancy story is the decoder TC one: static smem, 0 dynamic.
325	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
326	#if (SG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL == SG_GEMM_IMPL_WGMMA)
327	
328	// TC megakernel threads: 256 (the engine's producer+consumer warpgroup layout;
329	// wgmma is warpgroup-scoped on threads 0..127). We do NOT apply the scalar
330	// path's asymmetric setmaxnreg (it would STARVE the MMA warpgroup); the
331	// validated selftest ran no split. We match it.
332	#define SG_VIT_TC_MEGA_BLOCK 256
333	
334	// ── smem arena for the unpipelined engine: one A(64×16) + one B(N×16) bf16 tile
335	//    + the 256-float reduction slot + the 10 dW specs (identical for all threads
336	//    → shared, not per-thread stack). 16B-aligned. N = SG_TUNED_TILE_N. ──
337	struct VitTcSmem {
338	    __nv_bfloat16 sA[64 * 16];
339	    __nv_bfloat16 sB[SG_TUNED_TILE_N * 16];
340	    float red[256];
341	    vittc::VitDwSpec spec[10];
342	};
343	
344	// ── TC workspace layout (carved from in.workspace; the host sizes it). Regions
345	//    (float units):
346	//      [0 .. acts_f)                      : VitActs bf16 region (reinterpreted)
347	//      [acts_f .. acts_f + nCTA*scratch)  : per-CTA tile scratch (f32)
348	//      [.. + nCTA*kLnVecElems)            : per-CTA LN-vec partials (f32)
349	//      [.. + nCTA)                        : per-CTA loss slots (f32)
350	//      [.. + 1)                           : reduced scalar loss (host reads it)
351	//    acts_f = ceil(acts_bf16 / 2). ──
352	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_acts_floats(int T, int B) {
353	    return (vittc::vit_acts_bf16_count(T, B) + 1) / 2;
354	}
355	// dW split-K partial floats (0 when G==1 → no extra scratch, the single-CTA path).
356	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_dw_part_floats() {
357	    return vittc::vit_dw_part_floats(vittc::kVitDwSplitK);
358	}
359	// STAGED-optimizer cross-CTA reduction scratch (Prodigy d-estimate). The Prodigy
360	// stage publishes per-CTA (r,s) slots (2*nCTA) + a reduced-d slot (1) — an owner-
361	// computes tree (opt_stages_precompute.cuh), NO float atomic. Sized for the LARGEST
362	// nCTA (one CTA/SM = #SMs); tiny (≤ 2*132+1 floats) and carved UNCONDITIONALLY so
363	// the opt-agnostic launcher allocates one workspace fitting every OptId. Unused by
364	// AdamW/Lion/… (their P3 never touches it) → those cells stay byte-identical.
365	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(int nCTA) {
366	    return (int64_t)2 * nCTA + 1;            // [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
367	}
368	// ── Muon (STAGED grid-cooperative Newton-Schulz) per-matrix scratch. The NS chain
369	//    runs ONE 2D weight at a time over all CTAs; the scratch holds X/A/AX/AAX/orth
370	//    for the LARGEST 2D weight + the per-CTA Frobenius-norm partials + inv_norm. The
371	//    momentum buffer (muon_buf) is NOT here — it PERSISTS across steps as optimizer
372	//    state, bound to the m slice (st.exp_avg). Largest vit 2D weight: ff0/ff2 = 512×
373	//    128 = 65536 numel; largest rows = 512 ⇒ A = 512×512. Carved UNCONDITIONALLY
374	//    (≈ 4·65536 + 512² + nCTA + 1 floats ≈ 2 MB) so the opt-agnostic launcher fits
375	//    every OptId; unused by every non-Muon cell (byte-identical). ──
376	//    kVitMuonMaxNumel = max over 2D weights of rows*cols; kVitMuonMaxRows = max rows.
377	static constexpr int kVitMuonMaxNumel = vit::kDff * vit::kD;     // 512*128 = 65536 (ff0/ff2)
378	static constexpr int kVitMuonMaxRows  = vit::kDff;               // 512 (ff0 rows)
379	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_muon_floats(int nCTA) {
380	    // X + AX + AAX + orth (each maxNumel) + A (maxRows²) + nrm_partials(nCTA) + inv_norm(1)
381	    return (int64_t)4 * kVitMuonMaxNumel
382	         + (int64_t)kVitMuonMaxRows * kVitMuonMaxRows
383	         + nCTA + 1;
384	}
385	// ── LookSAM (STAGED in-kernel SAM 2nd backward) transient scratch — the ViT twin of
386	//    the decoder's dec_tc_looksam_floats (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh). The SAM step
387	//    perturbs p in place, runs a SECOND fwd+bwd at p', and needs (a) a param BACKUP for
388	//    the exact restore (eager clones p before perturbing; an fp32 add is not bit-
389	//    reversible, so save — don't subtract back) + (b) a SEPARATE g_sam grad buffer so
390	//    the 2nd backward does NOT clobber the first grad `grad` (sam_dir = g_sam − grad
391	//    reads both). Both are total-sized + transient (NOT persistent state — sam_dir
392	//    itself persists in the `extra` state slice, bound by the cell). Carved
393	//    UNCONDITIONALLY (≈ 2·kVitTotalElems ≈ 3.3 MB) so the opt-agnostic launcher fits
394	//    every OptId; unused by every non-LookSAM cell (its P2.4 phase is if-constexpr'd
395	//    out → byte-identical). The ‖g‖ reduction reuses the loss workspace (sq_part/ron_bc,
396	//    as GrokAdamW's P2.5 / the decoder twin do), so no extra here. ──
397	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_looksam_floats() {
398	    return (int64_t)2 * kVitTotalElems;       // [sam_backup | sam_grad]
399	}
400	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_tc_workspace_floats(int T, int B, int nCTA) {
401	    return vit_tc_acts_floats(T, B)
402	         + (int64_t)nCTA * vittc::vit_tile_scratch_total_f32()
403	         + (int64_t)nCTA * vittc::kLnVecElems
404	         + nCTA + 1
405	         + vit_tc_dw_part_floats()           // split-K dW partials (G>1)
406	         + vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA)    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots
407	         + vit_tc_muon_floats(nCTA)          // STAGED-opt (Muon) NS per-matrix scratch
408	         + vit_tc_looksam_floats();          // STAGED-opt (LookSAM) SAM 2nd-bwd scratch
409	}

422	template <OptId Opt>
423	__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SG_VIT_TC_MEGA_BLOCK)
424	fused_vit_megakernel_tc(PersistentContext ctx,
425	                        float* __restrict__ params,
426	                        ViTInputCtx in,
427	                        float* __restrict__ grad,
428	                        float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
429	    __shared__ VitTcSmem sm;
430	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
431	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
432	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
433	    const int B = in.B;
434	    const int T = B * vit::kSeq;
435	    const int Tp = B * vit::kNPatch;
436	
437	    // Workspace partition.
438	    float* ws = in.workspace;
439	    const int64_t acts_f = vit_tc_acts_floats(T, B);
440	    __nv_bfloat16* acts_base = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(ws);
441	    float* scratch_base = ws + acts_f;
442	    const int64_t scratch_per = vittc::vit_tile_scratch_total_f32();
443	    float* lnvec_base = scratch_base + (int64_t)nCTA * scratch_per;
444	    float* loss_part  = lnvec_base + (int64_t)nCTA * vittc::kLnVecElems;
445	    float* loss_out   = loss_part + nCTA;
446	    // Split-K dW partials (G>1): the (gt,kc) 64×N partial tiles, carved AFTER the
447	    // loss slot (matches vit_tc_workspace_floats's term order). G==1 → dw_part unused.
448	    float* dw_part    = loss_out + 1;
449	    const int kDwG    = vittc::kVitDwSplitK;
450	    // STAGED-opt cross-CTA reduce slots (Prodigy d), carved AFTER the dW partials
451	    // (matches vit_tc_workspace_floats's term order). Unused unless Opt==Prodigy.
452	    float* opt_reduce = dw_part + vit_tc_dw_part_floats();
453	    // Muon NS per-matrix scratch, carved AFTER the Prodigy reduce slots (matches
454	    // vit_tc_workspace_floats's term order). Unused unless Opt==Muon. Layout:
455	    //   [muon_X | muon_AX | muon_AAX | muon_orth] (each kVitMuonMaxNumel)
456	    //   [muon_A (kVitMuonMaxRows²)] [nrm_partials (nCTA)] [inv_norm (1)]
457	    float* muon_base = opt_reduce + vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);
458	    // LookSAM SAM 2nd-backward scratch, carved AFTER the Muon scratch (term order
459	    // matches vit_tc_workspace_floats — carving it LAST keeps every prior region's
460	    // offset unchanged, so the already-green cells are byte-identical). Layout:
461	    //   [sam_backup (total)] [sam_grad (total)]. Unused unless Opt==LookSAM.
462	    float* sam_backup = muon_base + vit_tc_muon_floats(nCTA);
463	    float* sam_grad   = sam_backup + kVitTotalElems;
464	
465	    vittc::VitActs acts = vittc::vit_acts_bind(acts_base, T, B);
466	    vittc::VitTileScratch sc = vittc::vit_tile_scratch_bind(scratch_base + (int64_t)cta * scratch_per);
467	    float* my_lnvec = lnvec_base + (int64_t)cta * vittc::kLnVecElems;
468	
469	    VitWeights w = vit_bind(params);
470	
471	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's LN-vec partials + loss slot (dW/cls/pos/patch grads
472	    //    are written-once → no pre-zero). ──
473	    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < vittc::kLnVecElems; i += blockDim.x) my_lnvec[i] = 0.0f;
474	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
475	    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots: INTEGRATION-OPTSTAGES.md §1 REQUIRES
476	    // prodigy_partials + prodigy_d zero-initialized before launch (the owner-computes
477	    // tree reads EVERY slot in ascending order; a CTA that claims no tensor in phaseA
478	    // still has its (r,s) slot read, and the persistent device workspace is NOT
479	    // re-zeroed between launches — so a stale slot from a prior step's reduction, or
480	    // garbage from the caching allocator, would make the cross-tensor d non-determi-
481	    // nistic / NaN). phaseA's block_reduce DOES write each slot, but zeroing here is
482	    // the contract guarantee + defends the prodigy_d broadcast slot. Guarded to the
483	    // Prodigy instantiation so every other cell is byte-identical (no extra work).
484	    if constexpr (Opt == OptId::Prodigy) {
485	        const int64_t n_opt = vit_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);   // 2*nCTA + 1
486	        for (int64_t i = (int64_t)cta * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < n_opt;
487	             i += (int64_t)nCTA * blockDim.x)
488	            opt_reduce[i] = 0.0f;
489	    }
490	    bar.sync();   // B0
491	
492	    // ── P1: token-tile-parallel fwd+bwd. Each CTA grid-strides over tiles of
493	    //    kTileM rows; for its tile it runs fwd (→ acts X, NLL) then bwd (→ acts
494	    //    dY, dh0, LN-vec partials). Barrier-free within the tile. ──
495	    const int nrows_tile = vittc::kTileM;
496	    const int n_tiles = (T + nrows_tile - 1) / nrows_tile;
497	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;
498	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
499	    unsigned long long prof_fwd = 0, prof_bwd = 0;
500	#endif
501	    for (int ti = cta; ti < n_tiles; ti += nCTA) {
502	        const int g0 = ti * nrows_tile;
503	        const int nrows = (T - g0) < nrows_tile ? (T - g0) : nrows_tile;
504	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
505	        __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _c0 = clock64();
506	#endif
507	        float nll = vittc::vittc_forward_tile(w, g0, nrows, acts, sc, in.patches, in.targets,
508	                                              sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red);
509	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
510	        __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _c1 = clock64();
511	#endif
512	        vittc::vittc_backward_tile(w, g0, nrows, B, acts, sc, in.targets,
513	                                   my_lnvec, sc.work2, sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red);
514	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
515	        __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _c2 = clock64();
516	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) { prof_fwd += _c1 - _c0; prof_bwd += _c2 - _c1; }
517	#endif
518	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;
519	        __syncthreads();
520	    }
521	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
522	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
523	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
524	        atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[0], prof_fwd);
525	        atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[1], prof_bwd);
526	    }
527	    unsigned long long _b1a = (threadIdx.x == 0) ? clock64() : 0;
528	#endif
529	    bar.sync();   // B1: all acts (X + dY) + LN-vec partials complete
530	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
531	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) { unsigned long long _b1b = clock64(); atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[2], _b1b - _b1a); }
532	#endif
533	
534	    // ── P2: assemble all 32 grads into `grad`. dW output-stationary (gt % nCTA),
535	    //    biases, cls/pos owner-scan, LN-vec reduce. No partials. The 10 dW specs
536	    //    are built into SHARED smem (thread 0; identical for all). ──
537	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) vittc::vittc_build_dw_specs(acts, B, T, Tp, sm.spec);
538	    __syncthreads();
539	    vittc::VitDwSpec* spec = sm.spec;
540	    const int n_dw = vittc::vittc_dw_total_tiles<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec);
541	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
542	    __syncthreads(); unsigned long long _dwa = (threadIdx.x == 0) ? clock64() : 0;
543	#endif
544	    if (kDwG > 1) {
545	        // SPLIT-K (multi-CTA tiling): fan (n_dw·G) (tile,chunk) partials over the
546	        // grid so the ~60% idle SMs do work; deterministic ascending-chunk reduce.
547	        for (int item = cta; item < n_dw * kDwG; item += nCTA) {
548	            const int gt = item / kDwG, kc = item % kDwG;
549	            vittc::vittc_dw_run_tile_splitk<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec, gt, kc, kDwG, acts.dh0, dw_part, sm.sA, sm.sB);
550	        }
551	        bar.sync();   // all (gt,kc) partials complete before the reduce reads them
552	        vittc::vittc_dw_reduce_splitk<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec, n_dw, kDwG, dw_part, grad, cta, nCTA);
553	    } else {
554	        for (int gt = cta; gt < n_dw; gt += nCTA)
555	            vittc::vittc_dw_run_tile<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec, gt, acts.dh0, grad, sm.sA, sm.sB);
556	    }
557	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
558	    __syncthreads();
559	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) { unsigned long long _dwb = clock64(); atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[3], _dwb - _dwa); }
560	    unsigned long long _gaa = (threadIdx.x == 0) ? clock64() : 0;
561	#endif
562	    vittc::vittc_dw_biases(spec, acts.dh0, grad, cta, nCTA);
563	    vittc::vittc_clspos_owner_scan(acts, T, grad, cta, nCTA);
564	    vittc::vittc_lnvec_reduce(lnvec_base, grad, nCTA, cta);
565	    // Loss reduce (fp64) by CTA 0.
566	    if (cta == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
567	        double s = 0.0;
568	        for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c) s += (double)loss_part[c];
569	        *in.loss_out = (float)(s / (double)B);
570	    }
571	    (void)loss_out;
572	#ifdef SG_VIT_PROFILE
573	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) { unsigned long long _gab = clock64(); atomicMax(&g_vit_prof_max[4], _gab - _gaa); }
574	#endif
575	    bar.sync_reset(ctx.g_next_task);   // B2: reduced grad ready; reset queue
576	
577	    // ── P2.4 (LookSAM ONLY, SAM steps): the MODEL-COUPLED SAM 2nd backward that
578	    //    produces st.sam_dir = g_sam − g (INTEGRATION-OPTSTAGES §6). PORT of the
579	    //    decoder twin's P2.4 (fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh) onto the ViT tile fns.
580	    //    Eager LookSAM, every k steps (looksam.py sam_step + looksam.h):
581	    //      ‖g‖     = GLOBAL L2 norm over ALL reduced grads; rho_over_norm = rho/‖g‖
582	    //      p'      = p + rho_over_norm·g          (perturb in the grad direction;
583	    //                backup = p.clone() for the exact restore — fp32 add is not
584	    //                bit-reversible, so we MUST save, not subtract back)
585	    //      g_sam   = ∇L(p')                       (a FULL SECOND in-kernel fwd+bwd +
586	    //                deterministic grad assembly at the perturbed weights, written to
587	    //                the SEPARATE `sam_grad` buffer so `grad` (the first grad the apply
588	    //                tail blends from) is untouched)
589	    //      sam_dir = g_sam − g                    (cached in the PERSISTENT `extra`
590	    //                state slice == st.sam_dir; reused verbatim on the k−1 intervening
591	    //                steps where looksam_sam==0, so NO 2nd pass runs then)
592	    //      restore p = backup
593	    //    The apply tail (P3, apply_optimizer<LookSAM>) then blends g_adj=(1−α)g+α·
594	    //    sam_dir and runs AdamW — UNCHANGED. DETERMINISM: the ‖g‖ reduction is the
595	    //    IDENTICAL deterministic ascending-CTA shape as GrokAdamW's P2.5 (fixed
596	    //    contiguous per-CTA range → per-CTA partial → CTA0 ascending sum), and the
597	    //    2nd fwd+bwd+assembly reuses the SAME A/A/A-clean machinery as the first pass
598	    //    (fixed tile ownership, ascending-k reductions), so the whole phase is
599	    //    deterministic BY CONSTRUCTION. Guarded so every other opt's path is byte-
600	    //    identical (no extra barrier / work). On a NON-SAM step (looksam_sam==0) this
601	    //    whole block is skipped — st.sam_dir already holds the cached direction.
602	    //
603	    //    SuperGrok11/15 SHARE this exact SAM 2nd-backward machinery (INTEGRATION-
604	    //    OPTSTAGES §4/§5): IDENTICAL perturb→2nd in-kernel fwd+bwd→restore; only the
605	    //    elementwise WRITE in (d) differs — LookSAM writes sam_dir = g_sam − g, SG11/15
606	    //    write sharpness = (g_sam − g)² (supergrok11_sm90.cuh:246 / supergrok15_sm90.cuh
607	    //    :315), the 2nd MLP input the P2.45 meta-net mu precompute reads. Same st.looksam_sam
608	    //    SAM-step gate + st.rho radius; cached sharpness reused on non-SAM steps.
609	    if constexpr (Opt == OptId::LookSAM || Opt == OptId::SuperGrok11 ||
610	                  Opt == OptId::SuperGrok15) {
611	        if (st.looksam_sam != 0.0f) {
612	            // (a) GLOBAL ‖g‖ over the reduced grad, deterministic (reuse the loss
613	            //     workspace as P2.5 does: loss_part[nCTA] = per-CTA Σg², loss_out[1]
614	            //     broadcasts rho_over_norm). The reduced loss is already in
615	            //     *in.loss_out (host state), so this is free scratch.
616	            float* sq_part = loss_part;          // [nCTA] per-CTA Σ g²  (ascending reduce)
617	            float* ron_bc  = loss_out;           // [1] broadcast rho_over_norm
618	            const int64_t total_e = kVitTotalElems;
619	            {
620	                const int64_t base = total_e / nCTA, rem = total_e % nCTA;

177	    // warpgroup 0, alloc<200> on warpgroup 1) — valid ONLY when warpgroup 0 needs
178	    // few registers. Mamba is NOT warp-specialized that way: ALL 256 threads do
179	    // SYMMETRIC selective-scan work, each thread owning a channel j∈[0,256) and
180	    // holding large register-resident scan state (fwd A[16]+h[16]; bwd adds
181	    // hh[kSeq+1][kState]+a_save[kSeq][kState]+dB_loc/dC_loc[kSeq][kState]+gh+dA),
182	    // so a dealloc<32> would spill it. __launch_bounds__(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK) sets the uniform
183	    // budget; the compiler allocates symmetrically across all 256 threads.
184	
185	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's grad-partial slice + its loss slot. ───────────────
186	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < total; i += blockDim.x) my_partial[i] = 0.0f;
187	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
188	    bar.sync();   // B0
189	
190	    // ── P1: batch-parallel fwd+bwd. Fixed contiguous slice [b0,b1) for this CTA.
191	    MambaWeights w = mb_bind(params);
192	    MambaGrad g = mb_bind_grad(my_partial);
193	    const int B = tok.B;
194	    const int base = B / nCTA, rem = B % nCTA;
195	    const int b0 = cta * base + (cta < rem ? cta : rem);
196	    const int cnt = base + (cta < rem ? 1 : 0);
197	    const int b1 = b0 + cnt;
198	    __shared__ int tok_s[mb::kSeq];   // this sample's token ids (broadcast)
199	    __shared__ int tgt_s;
200	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;              // fp32 slice accumulator (thread-0 holds it)
201	    for (int b = b0; b < b1; ++b) {
202	        if (threadIdx.x < mb::kSeq) tok_s[threadIdx.x] = tok.tokens[(int64_t)b * mb::kSeq + threadIdx.x];
203	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) tgt_s = tok.targets[b];
204	        __syncthreads();
205	        float nll = mb_forward_sample(w, tok_s, tgt_s, &sm);
206	        mb_backward_sample(w, g, tok_s, tgt_s, B, &sm);
207	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;   // fixed-order fp32 sum within slice
208	        __syncthreads();   // sample boundary: all grad writes done before reuse
209	    }
210	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
211	    bar.sync();   // B1: all CTA partials + loss slots complete
212	
213	    // ── P2: deterministic cross-CTA reduce. Work-steal the param ELEMENT-RANGES
214	    //    (one task = one parameter tensor; sum its elements across CTAs in
215	    //    ascending CTA index). Summation ORDER (ascending cta) is fixed →
216	    //    deterministic regardless of which CTA grabs the task. ─────────────────
217	    {
218	        __shared__ int task_slot;
219	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
220	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kMambaNumTensors;
221	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
222	            const int n = kMambaSizes[t];
223	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kMambaOffsets[t];
224	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x) {
225	                float acc = 0.0f;
226	                for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c)
227	                    acc += tok.workspace[(int64_t)c * total + off + i];
228	                grad[off + i] = acc;
229	            }
230	        }
231	    }
232	    // Loss reduction (fp64 ordered) by CTA 0 only — the loss rel-tol is the
233	    // tightest gate; fp32 atomic-summing many terms can miss it.
234	    if (cta == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
235	        double s = 0.0;
236	        for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c) s += (double)loss_part[c];
237	        float mean = (float)(s / (double)B);
238	        *tok.loss_out = mean;
239	    }
240	    bar.sync_reset(ctx.g_next_task);   // B2: reduced grad ready; reset queue for P3
241	
242	    // ── P3: the REAL optimizer tail over the reduced grad (work-steal the 28
243	    //    tensors). apply_optimizer<Opt> is the canonical csrc/algorithms math. ──
244	    st.lr = lr;
245	    {
246	        __shared__ int task_slot;
247	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
248	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kMambaNumTensors;
249	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
250	            const int n = kMambaSizes[t];
251	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kMambaOffsets[t];
252	            const FusedOptState ts = mamba_rebase_state<Opt>(st, off);
253	            float* __restrict__ p = params + off;
254	            const float* __restrict__ gg = grad + off;
255	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x)
256	                apply_optimizer<Opt>(p, gg, (int64_t)i, step, ts);
257	        }
258	    }
259	}

261	// ── Host launcher — one persistent CTA per SM, 256 threads/CTA (2 warp-groups).
262	//    Mirrors launch_fused_decoder_megakernel's hang-freedom contract (occupancy≥1
263	//    or refuse), PLUS the DYNAMIC-SMEM opt-in that the Mamba footprint requires
264	//    (exactly as launch_fused_vit_megakernel does):
265	//      (1) cudaFuncSetAttribute(MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, kMambaSmemBytes)
266	//      (2) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes in the occ≥1 query
267	//      (3) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes at <<<...>>>
268	//    All three are mandatory; missing any one makes the launch silently fail. ───
269	template <OptId Opt>
270	cudaError_t launch_fused_mamba_megakernel(
271	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, MambaTokenCtx tok,
272	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream) {
273	    int dev = 0;
274	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
275	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
276	    int n_sms = 0;
277	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
278	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
279	
280	    const int dyn_smem = (int)kMambaSmemBytes;   // 145124 B (≈141.72 KB)
281	
282	    // (1) Opt in to >48 KB dynamic smem for THIS kernel. Without this the launch
283	    //     fails with cudaErrorInvalidValue (the static 48 KB default applies).
284	    err = cudaFuncSetAttribute(
285	        (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>,
286	        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dyn_smem);
287	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
288	
289	    // (2) Occupancy with the REAL dynamic-smem request (hang-freedom is honest).
290	    int occ = 0;
291	    err = cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
292	        &occ, (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>, SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK,
293	        /*dynamicSMemBytes=*/dyn_smem);
294	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
295	    // At least one CTA per SM must be resident or the grid barrier can never be
296	    // satisfied. ~141.72 KB dynamic smem fits the sm_90 ~227 KB cap at occ=1 (the
297	    // persistent megakernel is one-CTA-per-SM by design); if it cannot place one
298	    // block/SM, REFUSE rather than hang.
299	    assert(occ >= 1 &&
300	           "fused_mamba_megakernel: 0 blocks/SM — GridBarrier would hang. The "
301	           "Mamba per-sample smem (~142KB dynamic) + regs exceed one-block-per-SM "
302	           "occupancy on this device; reduce footprint or fall back to eager.");
303	    if (occ < 1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources;
304	
305	    const unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms;
306	    ctx.n_ctas = launch_ctas;
307	
308	    if (ctx.g_arrived) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_arrived, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
309	    if (ctx.g_generation) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_generation, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
310	    if (ctx.g_next_task) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_next_task, 0, sizeof(int), stream); if (err) return err; }
311	
312	    // (3) Launch WITH the dynamic-smem byte count.
313	    dim3 grid(launch_ctas), block(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK);
314	    fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt><<<grid, block, dyn_smem, stream>>>(
315	        ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st);
316	    return cudaGetLastError();
317	}

354	// ── PHASE PROFILER (default OFF; a separate measurement TU defines
355	//    SG_MB_TC_PROFILE to bracket P1-fwd/P1-bwd/P2/P3 with clock64() and write
356	//    per-CTA cumulative cycles to a profiling buffer carved from the workspace
357	//    tail). Production builds never define it → zero added code, zero ABI change.
358	#ifndef SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
359	#define SG_MB_TC_PROFILE 0
360	#endif
361	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
362	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS 8   // [p1fwd,p1bwd,p2,p3, p2-dwgemm,p2-reduce,p2-embed, witness]
363	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(v) do { __syncthreads(); if (threadIdx.x == 0) (v) = clock64(); } while (0)
364	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_ACC(slot, t0) do { __syncthreads(); \
365	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) prof[(int64_t)cta * SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS + (slot)] += (double)(clock64() - (t0)); } while (0)

371	// ── Static smem arena: kMbTcStages A(64×16) + kMbTcStages B(N×16) bf16 tiles
372	//    (the GEMM K-loop double-buffer ring — slot s at sA + s*64*16 / sB +
373	//    s*N*16) + the 256-float reduction slot + the scan-bwd cross-channel reduce
374	//    targets (dBmat/dCmat, [kSeq×kState] each) + the 8 dW specs (shared, not
375	//    per-thread stack). At S=2 + N=128 the ring is 2·(2KB+4KB)=12KB; MbTcSmem
376	//    total ~14.6KB ≪ the 48KB static cap (the TC launcher uses static smem). ──
377	struct MbTcSmem {
378	    __nv_bfloat16 sA[mbtc::kMbTcStages * 64 * 16];
379	    __nv_bfloat16 sB[mbtc::kMbTcStages * SG_TUNED_TILE_N * 16];
380	    float red[256];
381	    float dBmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
382	    float dCmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
383	    mbtc::MbDwSpec spec[8];
384	};

386	// TC workspace layout (carved from tok.workspace; host sizes it):
387	//   [0 .. acts_f)                          : MbActs bf16 region
388	//   [acts_f .. + nCTA*scratch)             : per-CTA tile scratch (f32)
389	//   [.. + nCTA*kPartElems)                 : per-CTA non-GEMM grad partials (f32)
390	//   [.. + nCTA)                            : per-CTA loss slots
391	//   [.. + 1)                               : reduced scalar loss
392	//   [.. + mb_dw_part_floats(G))            : split-K dW partials (G>1 only; the
393	//                                            (gt,kc) 64×N partial tiles P2 reduces)
394	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_acts_floats(int T) {
395	    return mbtc::mb_acts_floats(T);
396	}
397	// dW split-K partial floats (0 when G==1 → no extra scratch, the single-CTA path).
398	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_dw_part_floats() {
399	    return (mbtc::kMbDwSplitK > 1) ? mbtc::mb_dw_part_floats(mbtc::kMbDwSplitK) : 0;
400	}
401	// STAGED-optimizer cross-CTA reduction scratch (Prodigy d-estimate). Mirrors the
402	// decoder's dec_tc_opt_reduce_floats: the Prodigy P2.6 stage publishes per-CTA (r,s)
403	// slots (2*nCTA) + a reduced-d broadcast slot (1) — an owner-computes tree
404	// (opt_stages_precompute.cuh), NO float atomic. Sized for the LARGEST nCTA (one
405	// CTA/SM = #SMs); tiny (≤ 2*132+1 ≈ 1 KB) and carved UNCONDITIONALLY so the opt-
406	// agnostic cached launcher workspace fits every OptId. Unused by AdamW/Lion/… (their
407	// P3 never touches this region), so adding it leaves those cells byte-identical.
408	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(int nCTA) {
409	    return (int64_t)2 * nCTA + 1;            // [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
410	}
411	// ── LookSAM (STAGED in-kernel SAM 2nd backward) transient scratch — the Mamba twin of
412	//    the decoder's dec_tc_looksam_floats. The SAM step perturbs p in place, runs a
413	//    SECOND fwd+bwd at p', and needs (a) a param BACKUP for the exact restore (eager
414	//    clones p before perturbing; an fp32 add is not bit-reversible, so save — don't
415	//    subtract back) + (b) a SEPARATE g_sam grad buffer so the 2nd backward does NOT
416	//    clobber the first grad `grad` (sam_dir = g_sam − grad reads both). Both are total-
417	//    sized + transient (NOT persistent state — sam_dir itself persists in the `extra`
418	//    state slice, bound by the cell). Carved UNCONDITIONALLY (≈ 2·kMambaTotalElems)
419	//    so the opt-agnostic launcher fits every OptId; unused by every non-LookSAM cell
420	//    (its P2.4 phase is if-constexpr'd out → byte-identical). The ‖g‖ reduction reuses
421	//    the loss workspace (sq_part/ron_bc, as GrokAdamW's P2.5 / the decoder twin do), so
422	//    no extra here. ──
423	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_looksam_floats() {
424	    return (int64_t)2 * kMambaTotalElems;    // [sam_backup | sam_grad]
425	}
426	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_workspace_floats(int T, int nCTA) {
427	    return mb_tc_acts_floats(T)
428	         + (int64_t)nCTA * mbtc::mb_tile_scratch_floats()
429	         + (int64_t)nCTA * mbtc::kPartElems
430	         + nCTA + 1
431	         + mb_tc_dw_part_floats()                       // split-K dW partials (G>1)
432	         + mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA)                // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots
433	         + mb_tc_looksam_floats()                       // STAGED-opt (LookSAM) SAM 2nd-bwd scratch
434	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
435	         + (int64_t)nCTA * SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS * 2 + 2  // phase-profiler (doubles=2 floats) + align pad
436	#endif
437	         ;
438	}

440	template <OptId Opt>
441	__global__ void SG_MBTC_LAUNCH_BOUNDS
442	fused_mamba_megakernel_tc(PersistentContext ctx,
443	                          float* __restrict__ params,
444	                          MambaTokenCtx tok,
445	                          float* __restrict__ grad,
446	                          float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
447	    __shared__ MbTcSmem sm;
448	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
449	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
450	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
451	    const int B = tok.B;
452	    const int T = B * mb::kSeq;
453	
454	    // Workspace partition.
455	    float* ws = tok.workspace;
456	    const int64_t acts_f = mb_tc_acts_floats(T);
457	    __nv_bfloat16* acts_base = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(ws);
458	    float* scratch_base = ws + acts_f;
459	    const int64_t scratch_per = mbtc::mb_tile_scratch_floats();
460	    float* part_base = scratch_base + (int64_t)nCTA * scratch_per;
461	    float* loss_part = part_base + (int64_t)nCTA * mbtc::kPartElems;
462	    float* loss_out  = loss_part + nCTA;
463	    // Split-K dW partials (G>1): the (gt,kc) 64×N partial tiles, carved AFTER the
464	    // loss slot (matches mb_tc_workspace_floats's term order). G==1 → dw_part unused.
465	    float* dw_part   = loss_out + 1;
466	    const int kDwG   = mbtc::kMbDwSplitK;
467	    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy P2.6) cross-CTA reduce slots: [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
468	    // = 2*nCTA+1, carved AFTER the split-K dW partials (matches mb_tc_workspace_floats's
469	    // term order). Unused by every non-Prodigy tail (their P3 never touches it), so this
470	    // pointer derivation leaves those cells byte-identical.
471	    float* opt_reduce = dw_part + mb_tc_dw_part_floats();
472	    // LookSAM SAM 2nd-backward scratch, carved AFTER the Prodigy reduce slots (mamba has
473	    // NO Muon region — unlike the decoder/vit twins — so this follows opt_reduce; term
474	    // order matches mb_tc_workspace_floats). Carving it here keeps every prior region's
475	    // offset unchanged, so the already-green cells are byte-identical. Layout:
476	    //   [sam_backup (total)] [sam_grad (total)]. Unused unless Opt==LookSAM.
477	    float* sam_backup = opt_reduce + mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);
478	    float* sam_grad   = sam_backup + kMambaTotalElems;
479	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
480	    // 8-byte align the double accumulator: round the float offset up to an even
481	    // count so reinterpret_cast<double*> is aligned (past the LookSAM sam scratch — the
482	    // phase-profiler is the LAST workspace term, mirroring mb_tc_workspace_floats).
483	    float* prof_f = sam_grad + kMambaTotalElems;
484	    uintptr_t _pa = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(prof_f);
485	    if (_pa & 0x7u) prof_f = reinterpret_cast<float*>((_pa + 7u) & ~uintptr_t(7u));
486	    double* prof = reinterpret_cast<double*>(prof_f);   // [nCTA*SLOTS], host-zeroed
487	    long long _pt = 0;
488	#endif
489	
490	    mbtc::MbActs acts = mbtc::mb_acts_bind(acts_base, T);
491	    mbtc::MbTileScratch sc = mbtc::mb_tile_scratch_bind(scratch_base + (int64_t)cta * scratch_per);
492	    float* my_part = part_base + (int64_t)cta * mbtc::kPartElems;
493	    mbtc::MbPartial part = mbtc::mb_partial_bind(my_part);
494	
495	    MambaWeights w = mb_bind(params);
496	
497	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's non-GEMM grad partial + loss slot. ──
498	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < mbtc::kPartElems; i += blockDim.x) my_part[i] = 0.0f;
499	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
500	    bar.sync();   // B0
501	
502	    // ── P1: sample-tile-parallel fwd+bwd. Each CTA grid-strides over tiles of
503	    //    kTileM rows; fwd (→ acts X, NLL) then bwd (→ acts dY, dh0, partial). ──
504	    const int nrows_tile = mbtc::kTileM;
505	    const int n_tiles = (T + nrows_tile - 1) / nrows_tile;
506	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;
507	    for (int ti = cta; ti < n_tiles; ti += nCTA) {
508	        const int g0 = ti * nrows_tile;
509	        const int nrows = (T - g0) < nrows_tile ? (T - g0) : nrows_tile;
510	        SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(_pt);
511	        float nll = mbtc::mbtc_forward_tile(w, g0, nrows, acts, sc, tok.tokens, tok.targets,
512	                                            sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red);
513	        SG_MBTC_PROF_ACC(0, _pt);
514	        SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(_pt);
515	        mbtc::mbtc_backward_tile(w, g0, nrows, B, acts, sc, part, tok.tokens, tok.targets,
516	                                 sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red, sm.dBmat, sm.dCmat);
517	        SG_MBTC_PROF_ACC(1, _pt);
518	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;
519	        __syncthreads();
520	    }
521	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
522	    bar.sync();   // B1: all acts (X + dY + dh0) + partials complete
523	    SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(_pt);
524	
525	    // ── P2: assemble all 28 grads. 8 projection dW output-stationary (gt %
526	    //    nCTA), dt_proj.bias, non-GEMM partial-reduce, embedding owner-scan. ──
527	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) mbtc::mbtc_build_dw_specs(acts, T, sm.spec);
528	    __syncthreads();
529	    mbtc::MbDwSpec* spec = sm.spec;
530	    const int n_dw = mbtc::mbtc_dw_total_tiles<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec);
531	    SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(_pt);
532	#if !SG_MBTC_BYPASS_DW_GEMM
533	    if (kDwG > 1) {

178	//  HBM bf16 ACTS buffer (Fork B). Carved from the FRONT of the workspace the
179	//  host allocates. Reinterpreted as __nv_bfloat16. All regions row-major
180	//  [rows × width]. Offsets are RUNTIME (depend on T = B*kSeq and B), computed

182	//
183	//  ViT ADDS X_patch (the float→bf16 patch input the patch_proj dW reads) and
184	//  REPLACES the decoder's tok/pos embedding adjoint plumbing with dh0 (the
185	//  post-cat, pre-pos grad) whose CLS rows feed cls_token and whose patch rows
186	//  feed patch_proj; pos is Σ over all rows by position.
187	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
188	struct VitActs {
189	    // Patch-proj input (the image patches as bf16, laid out as PATCH token rows
190	    // [Tp, kPatch] where Tp = nsamp*kNPatch — patch_proj dW = dh0_patch^T @ this):
191	    __nv_bfloat16* X_patch;               // [Tp, kPatch]
192	    // Per-layer linear INPUTS X (needed by dW = dY^T @ X):
193	    __nv_bfloat16* X_in[vit::kLayers];    // [T, d]    in_proj input (= layer input)
194	    __nv_bfloat16* X_ctx[vit::kLayers];   // [T, d]    out_proj input (attn context)
195	    __nv_bfloat16* X_x1[vit::kLayers];    // [T, d]    ff0 input (n1 output)
196	    __nv_bfloat16* X_gact[vit::kLayers];  // [T, dff]  ff2 input (gelu output)
197	    // Per-layer linear OUTPUT adjoints dY (needed by dW + bias db = Σ_t dY):
198	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_qkv[vit::kLayers];  // [T, 3d]   in_proj output adjoint
199	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_a[vit::kLayers];    // [T, d]    out_proj output adjoint
200	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_ff0[vit::kLayers];  // [T, dff]  ff0 output adjoint
201	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_ff2[vit::kLayers];  // [T, d]    ff2 output adjoint
202	    // Head (B rows — CLS position only):
203	    __nv_bfloat16* X_hn;                  // [B, d]    head input
204	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_logits;             // [B, V]    head output adjoint (dlogits)
205	    // Embedding-input adjoint (post-cat, pre-pos): cls/patch/pos owners read it:
206	    __nv_bfloat16* dh0;                   // [T, d]
207	};

209	__device__ __forceinline__ VitActs vit_acts_bind(__nv_bfloat16* p, int T, int B) {
210	    VitActs a;
211	    int64_t off = 0;
212	    const int Tp = (T / vit::kSeq) * vit::kNPatch;
213	    const int64_t Td = (int64_t)T * vit::kD;
214	    const int64_t T3d = (int64_t)T * 3 * vit::kD;
215	    const int64_t Tff = (int64_t)T * vit::kDff;
216	    a.X_patch = p + off; off += (int64_t)Tp * vit::kPatch;
217	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) {
218	        a.X_in[li]   = p + off; off += Td;
219	        a.X_ctx[li]  = p + off; off += Td;
220	        a.X_x1[li]   = p + off; off += Td;
221	        a.X_gact[li] = p + off; off += Tff;
222	        a.dY_qkv[li] = p + off; off += T3d;
223	        a.dY_a[li]   = p + off; off += Td;
224	        a.dY_ff0[li] = p + off; off += Tff;
225	        a.dY_ff2[li] = p + off; off += Td;
226	    }
227	    a.X_hn      = p + off; off += (int64_t)B * vit::kD;
228	    a.dY_logits = p + off; off += (int64_t)B * vit::kVocab;
229	    a.dh0       = p + off; off += Td;
230	    return a;
231	}

234	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t vit_acts_bf16_count(int T, int B) {
235	    const int64_t d = vit::kD, dff = vit::kDff, V = vit::kVocab, L = vit::kLayers;

244	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
245	//  Canonical Major-K smem stager (LIFTED verbatim from the decoder TC twin —
246	//  the wgmma engine is model-agnostic). Writes ONE MN×16 tile in the CUTLASS
247	//  Major-K INTERLEAVE layout (wgmma.cuh):
248	//      idx(mn,k) = (k/8)*(MN*8) + mn*8 + (k%8)
249	//  pulling element (mn, k) from a caller accessor `src(mn, kbase + k)`. Routing
250	//  the source axis through the accessor lets the SAME wgmma issue (TransA=0/
251	//  TransB=0, the substrate-validated orientation) serve fwd / dX / dW.
252	//  Cooperative over `nthreads` threads starting at thread `t0`.
253	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
254	template <int MN, typename Src>
255	__device__ __forceinline__ void stage_kmajor_tile(
256	        __nv_bfloat16* smem_tile, int kbase, Src src, int t0, int nthreads) {
257	    #pragma unroll 1
258	    for (int i = t0; i < MN * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK; i += nthreads) {
259	        const int mn = i / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
260	        const int k  = i % wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
261	        const int dst = (k >> 3) * (MN * 8) + mn * 8 + (k & 7);
262	        smem_tile[dst] = src(mn, kbase + k);
263	    }
264	}

266	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
267	//  Unpipelined single-CTA batch GEMM: D[M,N] = Σ_k A[m,k]·B[n,k], bf16 operands
268	//  (accessor-sourced + Major-K staged), fp32 accumulator, ascending-k. LIFTED
269	//  verbatim from the decoder TC twin (the engine is model-agnostic; only the
270	//  MaxAtomsM bound differs at the call sites — ViT's token tile is 17 atoms).
271	//
272	//  This helper computes ONE M-block of `m_atoms` stacked m64 atoms (rows
273	//  [mbase0, mbase0 + m_atoms*64)) for ONE N-tile of the compile-time atom width
274	//  N. The CALLER loops M-atom-blocks × N-tiles to cover arbitrary (M, N).
275	//  MaxAtomsM bounds the register accumulator array (compile-time); only
276	//  `m_atoms` (<= MaxAtomsM) atoms are issued at runtime. `n_real <= N` marks
277	//  the valid column count for a ragged N-tile (pad operands are zero → inert).
278	//
279	//  Determinism: ascending-k, one CTA owns the tile end-to-end, no atomics.
280	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
281	template <int N, int MaxAtomsM, typename SrcA, typename SrcB, typename Out>
282	__device__ void tc_gemm_block_unpipelined(
283	        int mbase0, int m_atoms, int n_real, int k_steps,
284	        SrcA srcA, SrcB srcB, Out out,
285	        __nv_bfloat16* smemA, __nv_bfloat16* smemB) {
286	#if defined(__CUDA_ARCH__) && (__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 900)
287	    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
288	    const int nthreads = blockDim.x;            // 256
289	    const bool in_wg0 = (tid < 128);
290	    const int tid_wg = tid & 127;
291	
292	    // ── CODEGEN FIX (correctness/codegen, NOT a perf knob): use ONE accumulator
293	    // reused per m-atom, NOT `WgmmaAccum<N> acc[MaxAtomsM]`. Each m-atom's
294	    // accumulator is FULLY CONSUMED (stored via out()) at the end of its
295	    // iteration before the next m-atom's k-loop begins (k==0 uses ScaleD=0 →
296	    // overwrite, no carry across atoms), so a single live accumulator is
297	    // numerically identical. The array version indexed `acc[a]` under the
298	    // `#pragma unroll 1` runtime-`a` loop, which GPU registers cannot address
299	    // dynamically → ptxas placed the 17-wide (vit kAtomsM) array in LOCAL memory
300	    // (5024 B stack frame) and emitted C7515: "wgmma.mma_async serialized due to
301	    // non-wgmma instructions DEFINING accumulator registers" — i.e. every wgmma
302	    // was forced to fully serialize around the local-mem round-trip of acc[a].
303	    // The single register-resident accumulator removes that serialization. The
304	    // ascending-k order + one-CTA tile ownership (determinism) are unchanged.
305	    #pragma unroll 1
306	    for (int a = 0; a < m_atoms; ++a) {
307	        wgs::WgmmaAccum<N> acc;
308	        const int mbase = mbase0 + a * wgs::kWgmmaAtomM;
309	        if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_fence();
310	        #pragma unroll 1
311	        for (int k = 0; k < k_steps; ++k) {
312	            stage_kmajor_tile<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM>(
313	                smemA, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
314	                [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcA(mbase + mn, kk); },
315	                tid, nthreads);
316	            stage_kmajor_tile<N>(
317	                smemB, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
318	                [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcB(mn, kk); },
319	                tid, nthreads);
320	            __syncthreads();   // staged tile visible to the whole CTA
321	            if (in_wg0) {
322	                wgs::SmemDesc dA = wgs::make_desc_A_kmajor<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(smemA);
323	                wgs::SmemDesc dB = wgs::make_desc_B_kmajor<N, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(smemB);
324	                if (k == 0)
325	                    wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/0, 0, 0>(acc, dA, dB);
326	                else
327	                    wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/1, 0, 0>(acc, dA, dB);
328	                wgs::wgmma_commit_group();
329	                wgs::wgmma_wait_group<0>();
330	            }
331	            __syncthreads();   // MMA done reading smem before next stage overwrites
332	        }
333	        if (in_wg0) {
334	            #pragma unroll
335	            for (int i = 0; i < wgs::WgmmaAccum<N>::kRegs; ++i) {
336	                int row, col;
337	                wgs::wgmma_frag_decode(tid_wg, i, N, row, col);
338	                if (col < n_real) out(mbase + row, col, acc.c[i]);
339	            }
340	        }
341	        __syncthreads();
342	    }
343	#else
344	    (void)mbase0; (void)m_atoms; (void)n_real; (void)k_steps;
345	    (void)srcA; (void)srcB; (void)out; (void)smemA; (void)smemB;
346	#endif
347	}

350	//  THIN ORIENTATION WRAPPERS over tc_gemm_block_unpipelined — the THREE
351	//  accessor patterns the engine is silicon-validated on (fwd / dX / dW). The
352	//  driver calls THESE; it never re-derives the staging. N is the compile-time
353	//  wgmma atom width; the fwd/dX loops N-tiles internally. Weights convert
354	//  fp32→bf16 ON READ (deterministic; no bf16 weight buffer needed). Kin is
355	//  padded to a multiple of kWgmmaAtomK by the caller (49→64 for patch_proj).
356	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
357	
358	// (fwd) Y[M,Nout] = X[M,Kpad] @ W[Nout,Kin]ᵀ.  Tiles N over [0,Nout) in width-N
359	// atoms. M = m_atoms stacked atoms (kAtomsM for token tiles; fewer for the last
360	// ragged tile / patch tiles). Y bf16 row-major [M, Nout]. `Kreal` is the true
361	// contracted dim (<= Kpad); pad-K reads return 0 so they are inert.
362	template <int N>
363	__device__ __forceinline__ void vittc_gemm_fwd(
364	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ X, const float* __restrict__ W,
365	        __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ Yout, int Kreal, int Kpad, int Nout,
366	        int m_atoms, __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
367	    const int k_steps = Kpad / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
368	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Nout; n0 += N) {
369	        const int n_real = (Nout - n0) < N ? (Nout - n0) : N;
370	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
371	            return k < Kreal ? X[(int64_t)m * Kreal + k] : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
372	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
373	            int nn = n0 + n; return (nn < Nout && k < Kreal) ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)nn * Kreal + k]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
374	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) {
375	            Yout[(int64_t)m * Nout + n0 + n] = __float2bfloat16(v); };
376	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
377	            0, m_atoms, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
378	    }
379	}

389	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {

391	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Nout; n0 += N) {
392	        const int n_real = (Nout - n0) < N ? (Nout - n0) : N;
393	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 { return X[(int64_t)m * Kin + k]; };

396	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) { Yf32[(int64_t)m * Nout + n0 + n] = v; };

403	// K=Nout. W staged transposed: srcB(n=kin,k=out)=W[out·Kin+kin] (fp32→bf16).

406	__device__ __forceinline__ void vittc_gemm_dx_f32(

408	        float* __restrict__ dXf32, int Kin, int Nout,
409	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {

411	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Kin; n0 += N) {
412	        const int n_real = (Kin - n0) < N ? (Kin - n0) : N;
413	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 { return dY[(int64_t)m * Nout + k]; };
414	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
415	            int nn = n0 + n; return nn < Kin ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)k * Kin + nn]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
416	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) { dXf32[(int64_t)m * Kin + n0 + n] = v; };
417	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
418	            0, kAtomsM, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);

422	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
423	//  Per-CTA TILE SCRATCH (HBM). One tile's forward intermediates the backward
424	//  reads, reused across the tiles a CTA grid-strides over. Sized for kTileM
425	//  rows. DEDICATED, NON-ALIASED buffers per fp32 intermediate (HBM is not
426	//  scarce; the aliasing bug class is avoided). qkv/ff0pre/attn/n1·n2 caches are
427	//  [kLayers]-indexed (the fwd runs ALL layers then bwd runs ALL layers, so each
428	//  layer's bwd-read state must persist per layer — the "layer-0 grads wrong"
429	//  bug). fnx/fni (final norm) + transient dh/x1/finalin/logits/work/work2/dsc
430	//  stay single.
431	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
432	constexpr int kNSampPerTile  = kTileM / vit::kSeq;
433	constexpr int kAttnPerTile   = kNSampPerTile * vit::kHeads * vit::kSeq * vit::kSeq;
434	constexpr int kLogitsPerTile = kNSampPerTile * vit::kVocab;
435	
436	struct VitTileScratch {
437	    __nv_bfloat16* qkv[vit::kLayers];     // [kTileM, 3d]  per layer
438	    __nv_bfloat16* ff0pre[vit::kLayers];  // [kTileM, dff] per layer
439	    float* attn[vit::kLayers];            // [kAttnPerTile] per layer
440	    float* n1x[vit::kLayers]; float* n1i[vit::kLayers];
441	    float* n2x[vit::kLayers]; float* n2i[vit::kLayers];
442	    float* dsc;             // [kAttnPerTile] attention dscores (transient, bwd-only)
443	    float* fnx; float* fni; // final-norm LN caches (single)
444	    float* dh;              // [kTileM, d]    running adjoint wrt block output
445	    float* x1;              // [kTileM, d]    n1 output (fp32, residual base for r2)
446	    float* finalin;         // [kTileM, d]    last-layer n2 output (fp32, head input)
447	    float* logits;          // [kLogitsPerTile] per-sample CLS-pos logits (fp32)
448	    float* work;            // [kTileM, dff]  GEMM output / general fp32 scratch
449	    float* work2;           // [kTileM, dff]  second fp32 scratch (bwd dx1/dqkv)
450	};

471	__device__ __forceinline__ VitTileScratch vit_tile_scratch_bind(float* slab) {
472	    VitTileScratch s;
473	    __nv_bfloat16* b = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(slab);
474	    int64_t bo = 0;
475	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.qkv[li]    = b + bo; bo += (int64_t)kTileM * 3 * vit::kD; }
476	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.ff0pre[li] = b + bo; bo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kDff; }
477	    float* f = slab + (vit_tile_scratch_bf16_count() + 1) / 2;
478	    int64_t fo = 0;
479	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.attn[li] = f + fo; fo += kAttnPerTile; }
480	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.n1x[li] = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD; s.n1i[li] = f + fo; fo += kTileM; }
481	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) { s.n2x[li] = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD; s.n2i[li] = f + fo; fo += kTileM; }
482	    s.dsc  = f + fo; fo += kAttnPerTile;
483	    s.fnx  = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD;
484	    s.fni  = f + fo; fo += kTileM;
485	    s.dh   = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD;
486	    s.x1   = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD;
487	    s.finalin = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kD;
488	    s.logits  = f + fo; fo += kLogitsPerTile;
489	    s.work    = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kDff;
490	    s.work2   = f + fo; fo += (int64_t)kTileM * vit::kDff;
491	    return s;
492	}

494	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
495	//  TILE-AWARE SCALAR ELEMENTWISE STAGES (fp32, CTA-cooperative over kTileM
496	//  rows). Mirror the scalar oracle's per-row math (model_stage_vit.cuh) but
497	//  operate on a whole tile of `nrows` rows at once over HBM [rows×width].
498	//  Reductions reuse vit_block_sum / vit_block_max (whole-block, looped per row).
499	//  `red` is a 256-float smem reduction slot.
500	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
501	
502	// LayerNorm fwd over the last dim d, for `nrows` rows. y/xhat fp32 HBM [rows×d];
503	// inv fp32 HBM [rows]. gamma/beta fp32 [d]. Caches xhat+inv for the bwd.
504	__device__ __forceinline__ void vittc_ln_fwd_tile(
505	        const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ gamma,
506	        const float* __restrict__ beta, int nrows,
507	        float* __restrict__ y, float* __restrict__ xhat, float* __restrict__ inv,
508	        float* red) {
509	    for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
510	        const float* xr = x + (int64_t)s * vit::kD;
511	        float sum = 0.0f;
512	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) sum += xr[j];
513	        float mean = vit_block_sum(sum, red) / (float)vit::kD;
514	        float vs = 0.0f;
515	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) { float c = xr[j] - mean; vs += c * c; }
516	        float var = vit_block_sum(vs, red) / (float)vit::kD;
517	        float iv = rsqrtf(var + vit::kLnEps);
518	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) inv[s] = iv;
519	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
520	            float xh = (xr[j] - mean) * iv;
521	            xhat[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j] = xh;
522	            y[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j] = xh * gamma[j] + beta[j];
523	        }
524	        __syncthreads();
525	    }
526	}

528	// LayerNorm bwd for `nrows` rows: dy [rows×d] fp32, cached xhat/inv → dx [rows×d]
529	// fp32; ACCUMULATES dgamma/dbeta (summed over the tile's rows) into a per-CTA
530	// LN-vec partial slot gw/gb [d] (plain += : single owner thread per feature j
531	// across rows, deterministic — same rule as the scalar vit_layernorm_bwd).
532	__device__ __forceinline__ void vittc_ln_bwd_tile(
533	        const float* __restrict__ dy, const float* __restrict__ xhat,
534	        const float* __restrict__ inv, const float* __restrict__ gamma, int nrows,
535	        float* __restrict__ dx, float* __restrict__ gw, float* __restrict__ gb,
536	        float* red) {
537	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
538	        float dgw = 0.0f, dgb = 0.0f;
539	        for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
540	            float d = dy[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j];
541	            dgb += d; dgw += d * xhat[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j];
542	        }
543	        gw[j] += dgw; gb[j] += dgb;
544	    }
545	    for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
546	        const float* dyr = dy + (int64_t)s * vit::kD;
547	        const float* xhr = xhat + (int64_t)s * vit::kD;
548	        float sda = 0.0f, sdax = 0.0f;
549	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
550	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j]; sda += dxhat; sdax += dxhat * xhr[j];
551	        }
552	        sda = vit_block_sum(sda, red);
553	        sdax = vit_block_sum(sdax, red);
554	        float iv = inv[s];
555	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < vit::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
556	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j];
557	            dx[(int64_t)s * vit::kD + j] = iv * (dxhat - (sda + xhr[j] * sdax) / (float)vit::kD);
558	        }
559	        __syncthreads();
560	    }
561	}

563	// Per-sample FULL (bidirectional) self-attention FORWARD over a tile. qkv is
564	// bf16 HBM [rows×3d] (q|k|v). Writes ctx fp32 HBM [rows×d] and attn weights fp32
565	// to `attn_w` [nSamp×H×S×S]. Each (sample,head,qpos) row owned by one thread —
566	// identical math to vit_attention, looped over samples. DELTA 1 vs decoder: NO
567	// causal mask — every key kj contributes for every query qi.
568	__device__ __forceinline__ void vittc_attn_fwd_tile(
569	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ qkv, int nrows,
570	        float* __restrict__ ctx, float* __restrict__ attn_w) {
571	    const int nsamp = nrows / vit::kSeq;
572	    const float scale = vit::attn_scale();
573	    const int rows_per = nsamp * vit::kHeads * vit::kSeq;   // (sample,head,qpos)
574	    for (int r = threadIdx.x; r < rows_per; r += blockDim.x) {
575	        const int si = r / (vit::kHeads * vit::kSeq);
576	        const int rem = r % (vit::kHeads * vit::kSeq);
577	        const int hh = rem / vit::kSeq, qi = rem % vit::kSeq;
578	        const int qoff = hh * vit::kDhead;
579	        const int rbase = si * vit::kSeq;        // first row of this sample
580	        const __nv_bfloat16* qrow = qkv + (int64_t)(rbase + qi) * 3 * vit::kD + qoff;
581	        float maxs = -CUDART_INF_F; float sc[vit::kSeq];
582	        #pragma unroll
583	        for (int kj = 0; kj < vit::kSeq; ++kj) {   // FULL: every key position
584	            const __nv_bfloat16* krow = qkv + (int64_t)(rbase + kj) * 3 * vit::kD + vit::kD + qoff;
585	            float dot = 0.0f;
586	            #pragma unroll
587	            for (int t = 0; t < vit::kDhead; ++t)
588	                dot += __bfloat162float(qrow[t]) * __bfloat162float(krow[t]);
589	            sc[kj] = dot * scale; maxs = fmaxf(maxs, sc[kj]);
590	        }
591	        float denom = 0.0f;
592	        #pragma unroll
593	        for (int kj = 0; kj < vit::kSeq; ++kj) { float e = __expf(sc[kj] - maxs); sc[kj] = e; denom += e; }
594	        float invd = 1.0f / denom;
595	        float* aw = attn_w + ((int64_t)(si * vit::kHeads + hh) * vit::kSeq + qi) * vit::kSeq;
596	        #pragma unroll
597	        for (int kj = 0; kj < vit::kSeq; ++kj) aw[kj] = sc[kj] * invd;
598	        #pragma unroll
599	        for (int t = 0; t < vit::kDhead; ++t) {
600	            float acc = 0.0f;
601	            #pragma unroll
602	            for (int kj = 0; kj < vit::kSeq; ++kj) {  // FULL: all kj
603	                float vv = __bfloat162float(qkv[(int64_t)(rbase + kj) * 3 * vit::kD + 2 * vit::kD + qoff + t]);
604	                acc += aw[kj] * vv;
605	            }
606	            ctx[(int64_t)(rbase + qi) * vit::kD + qoff + t] = acc;
607	        }
608	    }
609	    __syncthreads();
610	}

612	// Global SAMPLE index of the si-th sample in a tile whose first token row is g0.
613	__device__ __forceinline__ int si_global(int g0, int si) { return g0 / vit::kSeq + si; }
614	
615	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
616	//  FORWARD over one TOKEN TILE (nrows = nsamp samples × kSeq positions), global
617	//  token rows [g0, g0+nrows). Tile-batched: the four per-layer linears run on
618	//  wgmma (M=nrows, N-tiled); attention/LN/GELU scalar fp32; head/CE scalar
619	//  per-sample. Writes VitActs X-inputs (bf16 dW operands), the per-CTA tile
620	//  scratch, and returns the tile's summed NLL (thread 0 holds it).
621	//
622	//  DELTA 2 (patch_proj embedding): X_in[0][CLS row] = cls + pos[0];
623	//    X_in[0][patch row 1+i] = patch_proj(patch_i) + pos[1+i]. The patch_proj is
624	//    a wgmma fwd GEMM over the tile's patch rows (M = nsamp*16 = kPatchPerTile,
625	//    K=49 padded to 64). The float patches are staged into X_patch (bf16) first,
626	//    then patch_proj reads them.
627	//  `patches` is HBM float [B, 16, 49]; `tgt_ids` HBM int32 [B].
628	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
629	__device__ float vittc_forward_tile(
630	        const VitWeights& w, int g0, int nrows, const VitActs& acts,
631	        const VitTileScratch& sc, const float* __restrict__ patches,
632	        const int* __restrict__ tgt_ids,
633	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB, float* red) {
634	    const int nsamp = nrows / vit::kSeq;
635	    const int npatch_rows = nsamp * vit::kNPatch;
636	    const int gp0 = (g0 / vit::kSeq) * vit::kNPatch;   // first PATCH row of this tile
637	    // ── Stage this tile's patches into X_patch (bf16) as patch token rows.
638	    //    Sample si's patch p is global patch row gp0 + si*kNPatch + p; the source
639	    //    is patches[(g0/kSeq + si)*kNPatch*kPatch + p*kPatch + c]. ──
640	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < npatch_rows * vit::kPatch; idx += blockDim.x) {
641	        const int pr = idx / vit::kPatch, c = idx % vit::kPatch;
642	        const int si = pr / vit::kNPatch, p = pr % vit::kNPatch;
643	        const int gs = si_global(g0, si);
644	        float v = patches[((int64_t)gs * vit::kNPatch + p) * vit::kPatch + c];
645	        acts.X_patch[(int64_t)(gp0 + pr) * vit::kPatch + c] = __float2bfloat16(v);
646	    }
647	    __syncthreads();
648	    // ── patch_proj: proj[pr, :] = X_patch[pr,:49] @ patch_w[d,49]ᵀ + patch_b.
649	    //    fp32 → sc.work (patch rows). K=49 padded to 64 (one m64 atom block per
650	    //    64 patch rows). M = npatch_rows (= nsamp*16) issued as ceil/64 atoms. ──
651	    {
652	        const int pm_atoms = (npatch_rows + wgs::kWgmmaAtomM - 1) / wgs::kWgmmaAtomM;
653	        const __nv_bfloat16* Xp = acts.X_patch + (int64_t)gp0 * vit::kPatch;
654	        // fwd into sc.work [npatch_rows, d] fp32 (Kpad=64, Kreal=49).
655	        const int Kpad = ((vit::kPatch + wgs::kWgmmaAtomK - 1) / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK) * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK; // 64
656	        const int N = SG_TUNED_TILE_N;
657	        const int k_steps = Kpad / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
658	        for (int n0 = 0; n0 < vit::kD; n0 += N) {
659	            const int n_real = (vit::kD - n0) < N ? (vit::kD - n0) : N;
660	            auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
661	                return k < vit::kPatch ? Xp[(int64_t)m * vit::kPatch + k] : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
662	            auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
663	                int nn = n0 + n; return (nn < vit::kD && k < vit::kPatch) ? __float2bfloat16(w.patch_w[(int64_t)nn * vit::kPatch + k]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
664	            auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) { sc.work[(int64_t)m * vit::kD + n0 + n] = v; };
665	            tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<SG_TUNED_TILE_N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
666	                0, pm_atoms, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
667	        }
668	    }
669	    __syncthreads();
670	    // ── Build X_in[0]: CLS rows (pos 0 of each sample) = cls + pos[0]; patch
671	    //    rows (pos 1+i) = proj(patch_i) + pos[1+i]. bf16. ──
672	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * vit::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
673	        const int r = idx / vit::kD, j = idx % vit::kD;
674	        const int g = g0 + r;
675	        const int sp = g % vit::kSeq;            // position within the sample
676	        float v;
677	        if (sp == 0) {
678	            v = w.cls[j] + w.pos[j];             // CLS + pos[0]
679	        } else {
680	            const int si = r / vit::kSeq;
681	            const int p = sp - 1;                // patch index 0..15
682	            const int pr = si * vit::kNPatch + p;
683	            v = sc.work[(int64_t)pr * vit::kD + j] + w.pos[(int64_t)sp * vit::kD + j] + w.patch_b[j];
684	        }
685	        acts.X_in[0][(int64_t)g * vit::kD + j] = __float2bfloat16(v);
686	    }
687	    __syncthreads();
688	
689	    for (int li = 0; li < vit::kLayers; ++li) {
690	        const VitWeights::Layer& L = w.layer[li];
691	        const __nv_bfloat16* Xin = acts.X_in[li] + (int64_t)g0 * vit::kD;        // [nrows,d]
692	        // qkv = Xin @ in_w^T + in_b   (N=3d, K=d). bf16 → scratch.qkv[li].
693	        vittc_gemm_fwd<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(Xin, L.in_w, sc.qkv[li], vit::kD, vit::kD, 3 * vit::kD, kAtomsM, sA, sB);
694	        __syncthreads();
695	        // add in_b (the fwd GEMM did W only; biases folded in scalar here for qkv).
696	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * 3 * vit::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
697	            const int j = idx % (3 * vit::kD);
698	            float v = __bfloat162float(sc.qkv[li][idx]) + L.in_b[j];
699	            sc.qkv[li][idx] = __float2bfloat16(v);
700	        }
701	        __syncthreads();
702	        // attention (FULL) → ctx (work fp32) + attn[li] weights.
703	        vittc_attn_fwd_tile(sc.qkv[li], nrows, sc.work, sc.attn[li]);
704	        // ctx bf16 → X_ctx[li] (out_proj input + its dW operand).
705	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * vit::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
706	            const int r = idx / vit::kD, j = idx % vit::kD;
707	            acts.X_ctx[li][(int64_t)(g0 + r) * vit::kD + j] = __float2bfloat16(sc.work[(int64_t)r * vit::kD + j]);
708	        }
709	        __syncthreads();
710	        // a = X_ctx @ out_w^T (+ out_b). fp32 → work.
711	        vittc_gemm_fwd_f32<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(acts.X_ctx[li] + (int64_t)g0 * vit::kD, L.out_w,
712	                                            sc.work, vit::kD, vit::kD, sA, sB);
713	        __syncthreads();
714	        // r1 = Xin + a + out_b → work (fp32).
715	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * vit::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
716	            const int r = idx / vit::kD, j = idx % vit::kD;
717	            sc.work[(int64_t)r * vit::kD + j] += __bfloat162float(Xin[(int64_t)r * vit::kD + j]) + L.out_b[j];
718	        }
719	        __syncthreads();
720	        // n1(r1) → x1 (fp32) + caches[li]; then bf16 → X_x1[li].
721	        vittc_ln_fwd_tile(sc.work, L.n1_w, L.n1_b, nrows, sc.x1, sc.n1x[li], sc.n1i[li], red);
722	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * vit::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
723	            const int r = idx / vit::kD, j = idx % vit::kD;
724	            acts.X_x1[li][(int64_t)(g0 + r) * vit::kD + j] = __float2bfloat16(sc.x1[(int64_t)r * vit::kD + j]);
725	        }
726	        __syncthreads();
727	        // ff0 = X_x1 @ ff0_w^T (+ ff0_b). fp32 → work; pre-gelu bf16 → ff0pre;
728	        // gelu(pre+b) → X_gact[li] (bf16).
729	        vittc_gemm_fwd_f32<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(acts.X_x1[li] + (int64_t)g0 * vit::kD, L.ff0_w,
730	                                            sc.work, vit::kD, vit::kDff, sA, sB);
731	        __syncthreads();
732	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * vit::kDff; idx += blockDim.x) {
733	            const int r = idx / vit::kDff, j = idx % vit::kDff;
734	            float pre = sc.work[(int64_t)r * vit::kDff + j] + L.ff0_b[j];
735	            sc.ff0pre[li][(int64_t)r * vit::kDff + j] = __float2bfloat16(pre);
736	            acts.X_gact[li][(int64_t)(g0 + r) * vit::kDff + j] = __float2bfloat16(vit_gelu(pre));
737	        }
738	        __syncthreads();
