188	        int mbase0, int m_atoms, int n_real, int k_steps,
189	        SrcA srcA, SrcB srcB, Out out,
190	        __nv_bfloat16* smemA, __nv_bfloat16* smemB) {
191	#if defined(__CUDA_ARCH__) && (__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 900)
192	    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
193	    const int nthreads = blockDim.x;
194	    const bool in_wg0 = (tid < 128);
195	    const int tid_wg = tid & 127;
196	    constexpr int S = kMbTcStages;
197	
198	    wgs::WgmmaAccum<N> acc[MaxAtomsM];
199	
200	    // Stage tile `k` of atom `mbase` into ring slot `k % S`.
201	    auto stage_k = [&] (int mbase, int k) {
202	        const int s = k % S;
203	        stage_kmajor_tile<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM>(
204	            smemA + (int64_t)s * kMbTcSmemA1, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
205	            [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcA(mbase + mn, kk); }, tid, nthreads);
206	        stage_kmajor_tile<N>(
207	            smemB + (int64_t)s * kMbTcSmemB1, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
208	            [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcB(mn, kk); }, tid, nthreads);
209	    };
210	    // Issue the wgmma reading ring slot `k % S` into acc[a] (ScaleD per k).
211	    auto issue_k = [&] (int a, int k) {
212	        const int s = k % S;
213	        wgs::SmemDesc dA = wgs::make_desc_A_kmajor<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(
214	            smemA + (int64_t)s * kMbTcSmemA1);
215	        wgs::SmemDesc dB = wgs::make_desc_B_kmajor<N, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(
216	            smemB + (int64_t)s * kMbTcSmemB1);
217	        if (k == 0) wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/0, 0, 0>(acc[a], dA, dB);
218	        else        wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/1, 0, 0>(acc[a], dA, dB);
219	    };
220	
221	    #pragma unroll 1
222	    for (int a = 0; a < m_atoms; ++a) {
223	        const int mbase = mbase0 + a * wgs::kWgmmaAtomM;
224	        // ── Prologue: stage tile 0 into slot 0; make it visible; fence. ──
225	        stage_k(mbase, 0);
226	        __syncthreads();                 // tile 0 visible to the wgmma below
227	        if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_fence();
228	        // ── Steady state (S=2 single-in-flight double-buffer): issue wgmma(k)
229	        //    on the already-staged slot k&1 (async), THEN stage tile k+1 into the
230	        //    OTHER slot (k+1)&1 — its HBM operand loads run CONCURRENTLY with the
231	        //    async MMA — THEN wait_group<0> (wgmma(k) done reading slot k&1) and
232	        //    __syncthreads (stage(k+1) visible AND slot k&1 reuse-safe for k+2).
233	        //    Invariant: stage(k+1)'s slot was last read by wgmma(k-1), retired by
234	        //    iter k-1's wait+sync; the per-iter wait_group<0> is load-bearing (it
235	        //    is what makes a slot reusable). S=1 collapses to the serial path
236	        //    (issue → stage(none for k+1 since stages share a slot)… handled
237	        //    below): for S==1 we stage k+1 into the SAME slot AFTER the wait, so
238	        //    it is bit-identical to the old per-k stage→sync→issue→wait. ─────────
239	        #pragma unroll 1
240	        for (int k = 0; k < k_steps; ++k) {
241	            if (in_wg0) {
242	                issue_k(a, k);
243	                wgs::wgmma_commit_group();
244	            }
245	            if (S > 1) {
246	                // Double-buffer: prefetch k+1 into the other slot, overlapping wgmma(k).
247	                if (k + 1 < k_steps) stage_k(mbase, k + 1);
248	                if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_wait_group<0>();   // wgmma(k) done reading slot k&1
249	                __syncthreads();                          // stage(k+1) visible; slot k&1 free
250	            } else {
251	                // Serial (S==1, single slot): wait, then stage next into the slot.
252	                if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_wait_group<0>();
253	                __syncthreads();                          // wgmma(k) done reading the slot
254	                if (k + 1 < k_steps) { stage_k(mbase, k + 1); __syncthreads(); }
255	            }
256	        }
257	        if (in_wg0) {
258	            #pragma unroll
259	            for (int i = 0; i < wgs::WgmmaAccum<N>::kRegs; ++i) {
260	                int row, col;
261	                wgs::wgmma_frag_decode(tid_wg, i, N, row, col);
262	                if (col < n_real) out(mbase + row, col, acc[a].c[i]);
263	            }
264	        }
265	        __syncthreads();
266	    }
267	#else
268	    (void)mbase0; (void)m_atoms; (void)n_real; (void)k_steps;
269	    (void)srcA; (void)srcB; (void)out; (void)smemA; (void)smemB;
270	#endif
271	}

273	// k_steps with PADDING: K is padded UP to a multiple of 16; the staging
274	// accessor must return 0 for k >= K_real (the pad rows). dt_proj contracts K=8,
275	// x_proj-dX contracts K=dbc=40 — NEITHER a multiple of 16. ceil, not floor.
276	__device__ __host__ __forceinline__ int kceil16(int K) {
277	    return (K + wgs::kWgmmaAtomK - 1) / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
278	}

281	//  THIN ORIENTATION WRAPPERS (mbtc_gemm_*). Three accessor patterns: fwd
282	//  (Y=X·Wᵀ), dX (dX=dY·W, W transposed-staged), dW (dW=dYᵀ·X, both transposed,
283	//  K=T). M = kTileM (kAtomsM stacked atoms). Weights convert fp32→bf16 ON READ
284	//  (deterministic; no bf16 weight buffer). PAD-AWARE: srcA/srcB return 0 for
285	//  k >= K_real so a K not divisible by 16 (dt_proj K=8, x_proj-dX K=40) is
286	//  zero-extended; n_real marks the valid output columns for a ragged N tile.
287	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
288	
289	// (fwd) Y[M,Nout] = X[M,Kin] @ W[Nout,Kin]ᵀ.  Tiles N over [0,Nout) in width-N
290	// atoms. Kin may be non-/16 (dt_proj Kin=dt_rank=8 → padded). Writes bf16
291	// Y [M,Nout] at `Yout` (the projection output, stored bf16).
292	template <int N>
293	__device__ __forceinline__ void mbtc_gemm_fwd_bf16(
294	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ X, const float* __restrict__ W,
295	        __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ Yout, int Kin, int Nout,
296	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
297	    const int k_steps = kceil16(Kin);
298	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Nout; n0 += N) {
299	        const int n_real = (Nout - n0) < N ? (Nout - n0) : N;
300	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
301	            return k < Kin ? X[(int64_t)m * Kin + k] : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
302	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
303	            int nn = n0 + n; return (nn < Nout && k < Kin) ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)nn * Kin + k]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
304	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) {
305	            Yout[(int64_t)m * Nout + n0 + n] = __float2bfloat16(v); };
306	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
307	            0, kAtomsM, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
308	    }
309	}

353	//  HBM bf16 ACTS buffer (Fork B). The projection-dW operands (X-inputs and
354	//  dY-adjoints) the cross-tile P2 dW owners read. Token-row-major [T, width]
355	//  (= sample-major [nsamp][kSeq][width] since rows are sample-ordered). Carved
356	//  from the FRONT of the workspace; offsets are RUNTIME (depend on T=B·kSeq).
357	//
358	//  The 4 projections' dW = dYᵀ@X needs, per layer:
359	//    in_proj  dW[512,128] = dxz^T  @ layer_in : X_in    [T,128], dY_dxz   [T,512]
360	//    x_proj   dW[40,256]  = dxdbc^T@ x_main   : X_xmain  [T,256], dY_dxdbc [T,40]
361	//    dt_proj  dW[256,8]   = ddtpre^T@ dt_raw  : X_dtraw  [T,8],   dY_ddtpre[T,256]
362	//    out_proj dW[128,256] = dyout^T @ y_gated : X_ygated [T,256], dY_dyout [T,128]
363	//  (dt_proj.bias = Σ_T ddt_pre — free P2 bias pass. in/x/out_proj have no bias.)
364	//  The HEAD (out.w/out.b) stays scalar → no acts. dh0 [T,128] feeds tok/pos owner-scan.
365	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
366	// (still in namespace mbtc — opened above)
367	
368	struct MbActs {
369	    __nv_bfloat16* X_in[mb::kLayers];      // [T, d]        in_proj input (layer input, bf16)
370	    __nv_bfloat16* X_xmain[mb::kLayers];   // [T, d_inner]  x_proj input (bf16 copy of x_main)
371	    __nv_bfloat16* X_dtraw[mb::kLayers];   // [T, dt_rank]  dt_proj input (bf16 dt_raw)
372	    __nv_bfloat16* X_ygated[mb::kLayers];  // [T, d_inner]  out_proj input (bf16 y_gated)
373	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_dxz[mb::kLayers];    // [T, 2*d_inner] in_proj output adjoint (bf16 dxz)
374	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_dxdbc[mb::kLayers];  // [T, dbc]      x_proj output adjoint (bf16 dx_dbc)
375	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_ddtpre[mb::kLayers]; // [T, d_inner]  dt_proj output adjoint (bf16 ddt_pre)
376	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_dyout[mb::kLayers];  // [T, d]        out_proj output adjoint (bf16 dy_out)
377	    __nv_bfloat16* dh0;                    // [T, d]        embedding-input adjoint
378	};

380	// Running bf16-element offset for the acts region (host + device must agree).
381	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_acts_bf16_count(int T) {
382	    const int64_t d = mb::kD, di = mb::kDInner, dr = mb::kDtRank, dbc = mb::kDbc;
383	    const int64_t Td = (int64_t)T * d, Tdi = (int64_t)T * di, Tdr = (int64_t)T * dr,
384	                  Tdbc = (int64_t)T * dbc, T2di = (int64_t)T * 2 * di;
385	    int64_t bf = 0;
386	    for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li)
387	        bf += Td + Tdi + Tdr + Tdi + T2di + Tdbc + Tdi + Td;   // X_in,X_xmain,X_dtraw,X_ygated,dY_dxz,dY_dxdbc,dY_ddtpre,dY_dyout
388	    bf += Td;                                                  // dh0
389	    return bf;
390	}
391	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_acts_floats(int T) {
392	    return (mb_acts_bf16_count(T) + 1) / 2;
393	}

395	__device__ __forceinline__ MbActs mb_acts_bind(__nv_bfloat16* p, int T) {
396	    MbActs a;
397	    int64_t off = 0;
398	    const int64_t Td = (int64_t)T * mb::kD, Tdi = (int64_t)T * mb::kDInner,
399	                  Tdr = (int64_t)T * mb::kDtRank, Tdbc = (int64_t)T * mb::kDbc,
400	                  T2di = (int64_t)T * 2 * mb::kDInner;
401	    for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li) {
402	        a.X_in[li]      = p + off; off += Td;
403	        a.X_xmain[li]   = p + off; off += Tdi;
404	        a.X_dtraw[li]   = p + off; off += Tdr;
405	        a.X_ygated[li]  = p + off; off += Tdi;
406	        a.dY_dxz[li]    = p + off; off += T2di;
407	        a.dY_dxdbc[li]  = p + off; off += Tdbc;
408	        a.dY_ddtpre[li] = p + off; off += Tdi;
409	        a.dY_dyout[li]  = p + off; off += Td;
410	    }
411	    a.dh0 = p + off; off += Td;
412	    return a;
413	}

415	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
416	//  Per-CTA TILE SCRATCH (HBM). The fwd-all-layers-then-bwd-all-layers order
417	//  (the decoder's line-377 lesson) means every sample's forward activations the
418	//  backward reads must be cached PER (layer, sample) — so `act` is typed as the
419	//  REAL scalar MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct, [kLayers][nsamp], letting the scalar
420	//  mb_scan_fwd/bwd be called VERBATIM with `a = &act[li][si]` (they deref only
421	//  a->dt_pre/Bmat/Cmat; no __shared__ assumption — so the cache is HBM, the
422	//  launcher stays STATIC-smem, no dynamic opt-in). Plus the residual chain
423	//  (layer_in / final_in) and the transient fp32 buffers the per-tile fwd/bwd use.
424	//  One slab per CTA (a CTA finishes a tile fwd+bwd before the next).
425	//
426	//  All per-sample scalar calls (scan/conv/LN) take a CONTIGUOUS [kSeq,width]
427	//  one-sample slice: `buf + si*kSeq*width`. Since rows are sample-major
428	//  (row m = si*kSeq + t), a token-row-major [T_tile,width] buffer IS that
429	//  sample-major slice — the TC projection's out(m,·) and the scalar fn's
430	//  [kSeq,width] view coincide with NO reshape.
431	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
432	struct MbTileScratch {
433	    MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* act[mb::kLayers];  // [nsamp] each — the bwd cache
434	    float* layer_in[mb::kLayers];   // [kTileM, d]      residual / layer input (fp32)
435	    float* final_in;                // [kTileM, d]      last-layer output (fp32, head input)
436	    // transient fp32 tile buffers (reused within a tile):
437	    float* xmain;                   // [kTileM, d_inner] silu(conv) (fp32, scan input + D-skip)
438	    float* work_di;                 // [kTileM, d_inner] general d_inner-wide fp32 scratch
439	    float* work_di2;                // [kTileM, d_inner] second d_inner-wide scratch
440	    float* work_d;                  // [kTileM, d]       d-wide fp32 scratch (LN in/out, residual)
441	    float* dbc;                     // [kTileM, dbc]     x_dbc / dx_dbc staging (fp32)
442	    float* fn_xhat;                 // [kTileM, d]       final-norm xhat cache (last pos used)
443	    float* fn_inv;                  // [kTileM]          final-norm inv cache
444	    float* logits;                  // [nsamp, kPHead]   per-sample last-pos logits (fp32)
445	};
446	
447	constexpr int kNSampPerTile = kTileM / mb::kSeq;
448	constexpr int kLayerActFloats = (int)(sizeof(MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct) / sizeof(float));
449	
450	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tile_scratch_floats() {
451	    const int64_t TMd = (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kD, TMdi = (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kDInner,
452	                  TMdbc = (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kDbc;
453	    int64_t f = 0;
454	    f += (int64_t)mb::kLayers * kNSampPerTile * kLayerActFloats;   // act[L][nsamp]
455	    f += (int64_t)mb::kLayers * TMd;                               // layer_in[L]
456	    f += TMd;                                                      // final_in
457	    f += TMdi + TMdi + TMdi + TMd + TMdbc;                         // xmain,work_di,work_di2,work_d,dbc
458	    f += TMd + kTileM;                                             // fn_xhat,fn_inv
459	    f += (int64_t)kNSampPerTile * mb::kPHead;                      // logits
460	    return f;
461	}

463	__device__ __forceinline__ MbTileScratch mb_tile_scratch_bind(float* slab) {
464	    MbTileScratch s;
465	    int64_t o = 0;
466	    for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li) {
467	        s.act[li] = reinterpret_cast<MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct*>(slab + o);
468	        o += (int64_t)kNSampPerTile * kLayerActFloats;
469	    }
470	    for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li) { s.layer_in[li] = slab + o; o += (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kD; }
471	    s.final_in = slab + o; o += (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kD;
472	    s.xmain    = slab + o; o += (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kDInner;
473	    s.work_di  = slab + o; o += (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kDInner;
474	    s.work_di2 = slab + o; o += (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kDInner;
475	    s.work_d   = slab + o; o += (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kD;
476	    s.dbc      = slab + o; o += (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kDbc;
477	    s.fn_xhat  = slab + o; o += (int64_t)kTileM * mb::kD;
478	    s.fn_inv   = slab + o; o += kTileM;
479	    s.logits   = slab + o; o += (int64_t)kNSampPerTile * mb::kPHead;
480	    return s;
481	}

483	// ── LN-vector + scan/conv grad partials layout (the NON-GEMM grads Fork B keeps
484	//    tile-local, reduced ascending-CTA in P2). Per CTA, in this dense order:
485	//      [0]            A_log  [d_inner*state]   (per layer ×L)
486	//      ...            D      [d_inner]
487	//      ...            conv_w [d_inner*conv_k]
488	//      ...            conv_b [d_inner]
489	//      ...            n_w    [d]               (per-layer norm)
490	//      ...            n_b    [d]
491	//      (after L layers) head norm_w [d], norm_b [d], head out_w [pHead*d], out_b [pHead]
492	//    Each is summed across CTAs in P2. The per-layer block repeats L times; the
493	//    head block once. The dt_proj.bias is NOT here (it is the free GEMM bias).
494	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
495	constexpr int kPartPerLayer =
496	      mb::kDInner * mb::kState   // A_log
497	    + mb::kDInner               // D
498	    + mb::kDInner * mb::kConvK  // conv_w
499	    + mb::kDInner               // conv_b
500	    + mb::kD                    // n_w
501	    + mb::kD;                   // n_b
502	constexpr int kPartHead =
503	      mb::kD + mb::kD                 // norm_w, norm_b
504	    + mb::kPHead * mb::kD + mb::kPHead; // out_w, out_b
505	constexpr int kPartElems = mb::kLayers * kPartPerLayer + kPartHead;
506	
507	// Typed view over ONE CTA's partial slab (so the P1 accumulators write by name).
508	struct MbPartial {
509	    float* A_log[mb::kLayers]; float* D[mb::kLayers];
510	    float* conv_w[mb::kLayers]; float* conv_b[mb::kLayers];
511	    float* n_w[mb::kLayers]; float* n_b[mb::kLayers];
512	    float* norm_w; float* norm_b; float* out_w; float* out_b;
513	};
514	__device__ __forceinline__ MbPartial mb_partial_bind(float* base) {
515	    MbPartial p; int64_t o = 0;
516	    for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li) {
517	        p.A_log[li]  = base + o; o += mb::kDInner * mb::kState;
518	        p.D[li]      = base + o; o += mb::kDInner;

559	        acts.X_in[0][(int64_t)g * mb::kD + j] = __float2bfloat16(v);
560	    }
561	    __syncthreads();

563	    for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li) {

565	        const __nv_bfloat16* Xin = acts.X_in[li] + (int64_t)g0 * mb::kD;   // [nrows,d] bf16
566	        // (a) in_proj (TC): xz = Xin @ in_w^T (N=2*d_inner, K=d). Route split → the
567	        //     LayerAct caches act[li][si].x_main_raw / .z (fp32, the scan/conv inputs).
568	        {
569	            auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 { return Xin[(int64_t)m * mb::kD + k]; };
570	            for (int n0 = 0; n0 < 2 * mb::kDInner; n0 += SG_TUNED_TILE_N) {
571	                const int N = SG_TUNED_TILE_N;
572	                const int n_real = (2 * mb::kDInner - n0) < N ? (2 * mb::kDInner - n0) : N;
573	                auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
574	                    int nn = n0 + n; return nn < 2 * mb::kDInner ? __float2bfloat16(L.in_w[(int64_t)nn * mb::kD + k]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
575	                auto out = [&] (int m, int n, float v) {
576	                    const int si = m / mb::kSeq, t = m % mb::kSeq; const int o = n0 + n;
577	                    if (o < mb::kDInner) sc.act[li][si].x_main_raw[t][o] = v;
578	                    else sc.act[li][si].z[t][o - mb::kDInner] = v; };

583	        __syncthreads();
584	        // (b) conv1d (scalar, per-sample) → act.conv (PRE-silu cache); x_main =
585	        //     silu(conv) → sc.xmain tile buffer (fp32) AND bf16 → X_xmain (x_proj dW operand).
586	        for (int si = 0; si < nsamp; ++si) {
587	            MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a = &sc.act[li][si];
588	            mb_conv1d_fwd(&a->x_main_raw[0][0], L.conv_w, L.conv_b, &a->conv[0][0]);
589	        }
590	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * mb::kDInner; idx += blockDim.x) {
591	            const int si = idx / (mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner);
592	            const int rem = idx % (mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner);
593	            const int t = rem / mb::kDInner, c = rem % mb::kDInner;
594	            float xm = mb_silu(sc.act[li][si].conv[t][c]);
595	            sc.xmain[(int64_t)(si * mb::kSeq + t) * mb::kDInner + c] = xm;

597	        }
598	        __syncthreads();
599	        // (c) x_proj (TC): x_dbc = x_main(bf16) @ x_proj_w^T (N=dbc=40, K=d_inner).
600	        //     fp32 → sc.dbc; split → dt_raw[:, :8] (→ bf16 X_dtraw + kept in dbc),

602	        mbtc_gemm_fwd_f32<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(acts.X_xmain[li] + (int64_t)g0 * mb::kDInner, L.x_proj_w,

604	        __syncthreads();
605	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * mb::kDbc; idx += blockDim.x) {

635	#else

638	            const int rem = idx % (mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner);
639	            const int t = rem / mb::kDInner, c = rem % mb::kDInner;

644	        // (f) gate+skip: y_gated = (y_scan + x_main*D)*silu(z) → sc.work_di (fp32)

646	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * mb::kDInner; idx += blockDim.x) {
647	            const int si = idx / (mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner);
648	            const int rem = idx % (mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner);
649	            const int t = rem / mb::kDInner, c = rem % mb::kDInner;
650	            const int r = si * mb::kSeq + t;
651	            MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a = &sc.act[li][si];

655	            acts.X_ygated[li][(int64_t)(g0 + r) * mb::kDInner + c] = __float2bfloat16(yg);
656	        }
657	        __syncthreads();
658	        // (g) out_proj (TC): y_out = y_gated(bf16) @ out_w^T (N=d, K=d_inner). fp32
659	        //     → sc.work_d; r = y_out + residual(Xin bf16→fp32) → sc.work_d.
660	        mbtc_gemm_fwd_f32<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(acts.X_ygated[li] + (int64_t)g0 * mb::kDInner, L.out_w,
661	                                           sc.work_d, mb::kDInner, mb::kD, sA, sB);
662	        __syncthreads();
663	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * mb::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {

685	    // ── Final norm + head + CE, scalar PER-SAMPLE on the LAST position only. ──

688	        const int rlast = si * mb::kSeq + (mb::kSeq - 1);

692	        float mean = mb_block_sum(sum, red) / (float)mb::kD;
693	        float vs = 0.0f;
694	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) { float c = hlast[j] - mean; vs += c * c; }

696	        float iv = rsqrtf(var + mb::kLnEps);

698	        // hn = xhat*norm_w + norm_b → sc.work_d row rlast (head input, fp32, scalar head).
699	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
700	            float xh = (hlast[j] - mean) * iv;
701	            sc.fn_xhat[(int64_t)rlast * mb::kD + j] = xh;

704	        __syncthreads();
705	        // logits[o] = hn · out_w[o] + out_b[o] (scalar head, fp32). Store sc.logits[si].

711	            #pragma unroll 4

713	            lg[o] = acc;

715	        __syncthreads();
716	        int tgt = tgt_ids[g0 / mb::kSeq + si];

718	        for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < mb::kPHead; o += blockDim.x) lmax = fmaxf(lmax, lg[o]);

1. **ROOFLINE.md notes scan dominance:** "mamba TC is scan-dominated, 0.46x slower" — the scalar per-sample scan (line 631-643) is sequential, not parallelizable across CTAs. **This limits Mamba TC's multi-CTA win** compared to ViT (which has dW as the bottleneck).
